x-raes-invariants.description: Every occurrence must resolve one matching compiled ACT-617 declaration and preserve participant, episode, controller, authority, policy revision, order, proposal, target, and semantic identity joins.
Proposal, approval, denial, direction, intervention, handoff, override, and cancellation remain distinct from action admission, execution, delivery, observation, and audit evidence.
